product_summary: Gayatri Rub Tech, Plot No. 2510, Ramol Cross Road, Phase IV, Vatva GIDC, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382445 (gayatrirubtech.com). Established 1979 by Prahlad Patel; partners named on site: Prahladbhai Patel, Jitendra Patel, Sanjay Patel — matches the claimed proprietor 'Sanjaykumar Prahladbahi Patel'. Self-described as 'Leading Mfg., Supplier & Exporter of world class quality rubber roller, steel Roller & anilox roller'. Real catalogue lines from the site's Products menu: (1) gravure printing & lamination rubber rollers; (2) solventless & base lamination rollers; (3) flexographic rubber rollers; (4) silicone rubber rollers; (5) rubber expander roller; (6) extrusion lamination chilling roller; (7) diamond cut roll / special groove & diamond cut rollers; (8) ceramic anilox roller & sleeve; (9) stereo roll; (10) aluminium roll; (11) PU rubber roll; (12) extrusion lamination rubber roller; (13) chrome anilox roller; (14) rubber roller for tape plant; (15) sleeves: solventless lamination sleeve, flexo mounting sleeve, rotogravure printing sleeve, flexographic printing sleeve. Application industries listed: aluminium foil, flexible packaging, foil, metal, narrow web printing, packaging, paper, plastic, printing, rice mill, steel, woven. Corroborating third-party listings: PMMAI (Plastics Machinery Manufacturers Association of India) member directory lists 'GAYATRI RUB TECH — Associate — Jitender P Patel, Sanjay P Patel — GRAVURE PRINTING, LAMINATION RUBBER ROLLERS, SOLVENTLESS, BASE LAMINATION ROLLERS'; clickedindia.net lists them under 'Rubber Rollers Companies in Ahmedabad'; drupa 2024 exhibitor profile (Messe Düsseldorf) and Labels & Labeling supplier listing confirm the printing/packaging-converting equipment identity.
comment: HS 8443 90 is 'parts and accessories of printing machinery used for printing by means of plates, cylinders and other printing components of heading 8442' — i.e. parts of printing presses. The declared code is only partially defensible: the gravure/flexo printing rollers and printing sleeves (rotogravure sleeve, flexographic printing sleeve, flexo mounting sleeve) are plausibly 8443 91/8443 99 as printing-machinery parts, but the company's core output is rubber-covered rollers and rubber/PU rolls, which are rubber articles of 4016 99 (or 4016 93 for gaskets/seals, 4017 00 for hard rubber). Lamination/chilling rollers and expander rollers for film converting machinery are more properly 8477 90 (parts of machinery for working rubber or plastics) or 8455 30 (rolls for rolling mills) depending on end use; ceramic anilox rollers/sleeves are engraved/ceramic-surfaced rolls (6909 19 ceramic articles, or 8443 99 as press parts); aluminium rolls are 7607 19 if foil/plain aluminium sheet. So: match_status = wrong/partial — the declared 8443 90 covers at most the printing-sleeve sub-line and misses the dominant rubber-roller business. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: the company stays in the base and the code is corrected to the actual product mix (rubber rollers 4016 99 as primary, with 8443 91/8443 99, 8477 90, 8455 30, 6909 19, 7607 19 as secondary lines), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry misclassification: the claimed industry 'IT и электроника' is plainly wrong — this is a rubber/elastomer roller manufacturer for printing and flexible-packaging converting machinery, not IT or electronics; the declared HS 8443 90 (printing machinery parts) is at least in the printing-equipment family, which contradicts the claimed IT/electronics industry label. Trader signs: none found — the site presents own manufacturing (factory space, 1979 establishment, in-house roller covering), and PMMAI lists them as a manufacturer member; no evidence of pure trading. Product lines missing from the declaration: rubber/PU/silicone rollers (the main line), expander rollers, chilling rollers, diamond-cut/groove rollers, anilox rollers and ceramic sleeves, aluminium rolls, tape-plant rollers — none of these are covered by a single 8443 90 line. IMPORTANT per rule 5: all of the above is catalogue/website and directory evidence only — no customs line, B/L or GST record was examined in this task (out of scope for the HS role), so the product range is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' as to actual shipments; the product identity itself is corroborated by three independent third-party listings (PMMAII directory, clickedindia, drupa 2024 exhibitor profile). No revenue, CIN, PAN or shipment figures are asserted here — not researched and left null.
